title: fix: exclude pollinations-ai from quest leaderboards
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Excluded the pollinations-ai GitHub account (ID 314960022) from the all-time and monthly Quest leaderboards. Its account permissions and earned rewards are unchanged. Added a regression test covering both boards.
